mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment (tenant_id, house_id, landlord_id, contact_phone, appointment_time, remark, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{houseId}, #{landlordId}, #{contactPhone}, #{appointmentTime}, #{remark}, 1, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = #{status}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
